README.Description: 喝药自动返还玻璃瓶：延迟数秒全面结算背包流水后发放，合并堆叠/入箱/丢弃等批量操作不会误发，生长无需任何指令

README.en-US.Description: Automatically refunds an empty bottle for every potion drunk: batches all inventory changes over a few seconds and settles them together, so stack merging, chest deposits and trash/drops never trigger false refunds; zero commands needed
